items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: You know talk about Jack Montrose writing, Marty Paich, and people like that and Shorty Rogers. I think they created what we call the west coast sound.

ctx.x: Claus? Yeah, I know who you mean, the crossover.

The good arranger I mean. You’ve got to remember he came on 30 years after these guys. You know talk about Jack Montrose writing, Marty Paich, and people like that and Shorty Rogers. I think they created what we call the west coast sound. But that was sort of in the arrangers’ hands, that feeling, but certainly the soloists were not influenced by that feeling.
I’m interested to see that you played with a good friend of Hamilton College, who is Joe Williams. I wondered how that came about and how you enjoyed your stint with him.
